top_risks: R1 (high): Lane B is NOT frontend-only. Deploy Dev runs on push to main for 'frontend/**' as well as api/services/shared/worker (apps/AA-CIS-App/.github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml:2-12), behind the shared.job preflight guard. AA-797 edits api/routers/admin.py, AA-798 needs migration 223 plus admin_pipeline.py and v1_tours.py, and AA-796 edits v1_tours.py. So EVERY AA-CIS-App PR, including frontend-only ones, joins the ONE serial train, and none merges during the T2 rerun or r5 windows. The plan-11 line 'frontend-only PRs merge any time' must be withdrawn. Only docs/tests/CONTEXT.md-only PRs skip the deploy, because those paths are not in the trigger list.

R2 (high): AA-792 edits the writer prompt builder shared by A1, T2 and Bedrock Batch (services/content_generation/batch_prompt.py:24 imports SYSTEM_PROMPT and build_rewrite_prompt from .prompts). Nothing pins the A1 prompt bytes. The first commit of the AA-792 branch must add an A1 golden SHA test captured on main@20a2387 BEFORE any prompt edit. The T2 variant must be a separate branch chosen only when state['is_tenant_rewrite'] is true. Otherwise A1 waves (AA-653) change silently.

R3 (high): the T2 rerun cannot attribute its results, and it overruns its budget. AA-792 changes the writer AND the judge gate in one release. AA-793 (best-draft-wins, ≤$0.20/version) is not scheduled, yet plan 11 says the rerun verifies 792/793/794. S234 cost $5.21 for 14 versions ($0.372 each), which is above the ≤$5 cap. Use judge brand_fit_score from llm_call_log.quality_signal as the before/after metric, not quality_score. Hard-stop the driver at $4.50. Drop AA-793 from the rerun Done-when.

R4 (high): schema drift on shared.v_tenant_monthly_usage. The live view (billing_month, llm_cost_usd, quota_*_pct), shared.membership_plans and shared.tenants.plan_id are not in any repo migration. The only definition is api/migrations/007_tenant_usage.sql:12-22, which has different columns. This drift causes the /usage 500 (admin.py:359-368). It also means AA-798 must DROP+CREATE the view as a baseline with explicit re-GRANTs, because CREATE OR REPLACE fails on the 007-shaped CI database.

R5 (high): the CIS CI/CD role aa-cis-dev-role trusts every repo in the org: sub 'repo:AdventureAsia365-Ecosys*/*:*' (infra/AA-CIS-Infra/accounts/aa365/cicd.tf:34). It has RDS/Secrets/ECS full access and iam:CreateRole/PassRole on '*'. If AA-Booking were created now it would inherit near-admin rights. Narrow the trust before `gh repo create`. Only AA-CIS-App (deploy-dev, eval-regression) and AA-CIS-Infra (terraform-plan/apply, db-migrate) assume this role. TripPlanner already uses its own aa-tripplanner-dev-app-deploy (apps/AA-TripPlanner-Web/.github/workflows/deploy-lambdas.yml:35), so narrowing is safe if the '*' after the org name is kept for the '@id' segment (cicd.tf:30-33 comment).

R6 (high): the subagent guardrail hook matches only Bash (.claude/settings.json:10). GitHub MCP merge_pull_request, create_repository and push_files, Linear save_*, and Vercel create_project are not blocked, so the pilot's 'subagents cannot merge or create repos' assumption is false. Before any implementer is spawned, the orchestrator must widen the matcher, or add an agent_id-gated deny for MCP write tools, and also add `gh api ... -f`, `aws ecs execute-command`, `aws iam` and `aws lambda invoke|update` to the Bash patterns.

R7 (medium): tenant data and cost leaks surface once Lane B makes things real. (a) AA-798 turns /v1/billing llm_cost_usd (v1_tours.py:270-285) into real AA LLM spend visible to tenants, so drop it from the tenant projection. (b) Once AA-797 makes suspend/offboard work, any staff role can PATCH, DELETE or offboard tenants through the BFF (frontend/lib/rbac.ts:66,75-85). Add a tenants write rule restricted to admin. (c) The AA-796 scope misses /v1/tours/{id} (pt.*) and the tenant branch of /v1/tours/{id}/full, which returns the full quality_scores and generated_content rows (v1_tours.py:613-735).

R8 (medium): the A-T9 issues collide pairwise on hot files: sentence_repair.py (776/786), quality_gates.py (785/786/773), atom_seed.py (774/773), claim_rules.py (773/786), and the single SHA-guard block tests/unit/test_aa771_s234_voice_contract.py:450-452 (773/775). render_brand_block (services/acp_shared/brand_pack.py:107) feeds T9, T8 and (after AA-792) T2. Exactly one implementer must own this track and work strictly serially.

R9 (medium): seed line format. AA-773 adds a 'Status:' line that contains 'optional' and 'not included'. quality_gates._is_offered (:451-453) would treat it as offered, unused_source_facts (:1256-1277) could inject it into FAQ answers, and moment_fact_count/claim_rules/trip_facts would mis-parse it. All parsers must be updated in the same PR, with a test that runs a Status line through unused_source_facts.

R10 (medium): Booking shares acc2 RDS, ALB/NLB/VPC link and the CIS job gate. The CIS deploy guard counts every queued/running shared.job row (deploy-dev.yml:29-63), so Booking jobs in shared.job would freeze CIS deploys. DB Migrate runs as the CIS api task's DATABASE_URL (infra/AA-CIS-Infra/.github/workflows/db-migrate.yml:88-105). Per tfvars:21 that is the master user aa_cis_admin, so it can CREATE ROLE/SCHEMA, but every booking.* object is owned by aa_cis_admin, and bk-001 must ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE aa_cis_admin.

R11 (low): there are stale orphan worktree folders under apps/AA-CIS-App/.claude/worktrees/* (gitdir deleted). Repo-wide grep returns old copies of quality_gates.py, prompts.py and migrations. Agent briefs must exclude that path, and new worktrees must use other names/locations.
